svg.title: Marathon: heart rate, pace and elevation over active workout time
svg.desc: Workout panels use active workout time; recovery panels use local wake dates. Heart rate: centered 15 s moving average, with gaps connected linearly on the chart. Pace: centered 15 s moving median. Elevation: centered 15 s moving average. Smoothing resets at pauses and gaps over 2 s. Pace gaps are connected linearly on the chart only; elevation retains measurement gaps. Pace and elevation axes double the smoothed min-max span around its midpoint; pace is bounded below by zero. Minimum data spans: 0.5 min/km and 1 m. Power: 15 s mean. Speed: 15 s median. Cadence, contact and estimated step length: observed dots with a 15 s median trend, without area fill. Dots are reduced preserving extrema. Cadence uses steps/min for running/walking and rpm otherwise. Step length = 30 * speed / cadence. Grade: local rise/run over up to ±25 m, minimum 20 m and three observations, then 15 s mean. No grade is estimated across missing inputs, pauses, distance resets or stationary samples. New axes double the displayed min-max span, including raw dots and zero for grade. All source data remain unchanged. Areas fill to the panel bottom except signed grade, which fills toward zero (green uphill, blue downhill). Missing metrics are omitted.

g.text: Elevation (m above sea level) · 15 s moving average
15 s smoothing; HR/pace gaps connected only on chart. Other gaps retained. Non-HR axes: doubled min-max span.
Dots: observed samples + median trend. Grade: 50 m rise/run; green uphill, blue downhill. Missing metrics omitted.
